why: I checked all four must_catch items and the briefs handle each one. (1) Verifier Check 3 runs `node $BIN a.jsonl missing.jsonl bad.jsonl` and requires exit 2, missing.jsonl named on stderr, and `bad.jsonl:2:`/`bad.jsonl:4:` still on stdout. That is the combined case, not each case alone. (2) Check 4 runs `git diff <merge-base with the PR base branch> HEAD -- packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js` and passes only on an empty diff. (3) Builder step 5 says "Update packages/jsonl-lint/README.md" and lists the multi-file usage, `-` and the exit codes. (4) Check 6 uses `gh pr view ... --json body,headRefOid` to find the `Closes https://github.com/suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test/issues/104` line. It also reads check-runs at headRefOid and requires the `test` workflow to have concluded success at the head SHA.
